lead.title: Vera Health raises $28.5M Series A (Threshold Ventures): its clinical search engine, used by 800,000 clinicians, digs into Europe
lead.deck: The tool, free for physicians and billed to hospitals for tailored versions, searches 60+ million papers, guidelines and drug labels, links each claim to its sources and grades the strength of evidence. It claims 800,000 clinicians in 190 countries — roughly one in four physicians in Spain and Italy, one in seven in France — with Optum Ventures, Mantis VC and SV Angel in the round and Y Combinator and Gradient reinvesting ($32M raised in total).

milestone.title: London's Emerald raises £1.4M, half Innovate UK, half venture capital, for its AI preventive health platform (announced Oct 20)
milestone.summary: Launched in May 2025 with £625k from angels, the startup is CQC-registered for diagnostic and screening procedures and a Class I medical device with the MHRA; the round brings total funding to about £2.9M.
milestone.why: An example of "regulated" preventive health: medical-device status and CQC registration set it apart from unregulated wellness platforms.

word.definition: Evidence on a treatment's or device's effectiveness and safety drawn from routine care data (patient records, registries, claims) rather than a randomized trial.

how.t: Data stays with the care centers, which structure and anonymize it.
It is converted to a common format (e.g. OMOP) so it is comparable across countries.
Federated studies produce evidence usable by industry, regulators and payers.

word.why: Regulators and payers increasingly ask for it for reimbursement; with the EHDS, platforms that make data usable without centralizing it become an infrastructure layer.
